name: Connectors
description: Make separable hydraulic, electrical and optical connections subsea/downhole, and connect flowlines/tie-ins; provide sealing and corrosion protection in hostile environments.

specifications.basis: TechnipFMC subsea infrastructure: all connection systems 'extensively tested and are qualified for internal pressures up to 20,000 psi and 3,000 m of water'
TechnipFMC: 'More than 3,000 of our connection systems are installed and operating worldwide'
OneSubsea wet connectors page, Application and Features
specifications.value: dual-barrier system for mechanical and electrical sealing; dielectric-filled compensation wiper system protects receptacle contacts; crimped cable terminations; male pin gives immediate corrosion protection on de-mating

specifications.basis: OneSubsea wet connectors page, Core benefits
specifications.value: deepwater and high-pressure/high-temperature wellhead and downhole applications; many dry- and wet-mateable connectors resistant to sour environments and sand/silt ingress
